name: Tameike no Hito
source:
The hot summer days are almost over. When main character heads to the club room, there is a girl in swimsuit there for some mysterious reason.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
炎热的夏天快结束了。当主角前往俱乐部房间时，不知为何出现了一名穿着泳装的女孩。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
